Active route: Catalog > Courses.

Key visual & layout structure:
1. Page Header:
- Title 'Courses' with counter badge '28 total'
- Secondary link/button: 'Manage Categories' (with folder/tag icon)
- Primary CTA button: '+ Create Course' (indigo-600 with white text, shadow-sm, rounded-lg)
- Quick KPI summary cards above or inline: Total Courses (28), Active / Published (22), Drafts (4), Total Learners Enrolled (18,420), Revenue this month (₹14,80,000)

2. Toolbar & Bulk Action Bar:
- Search input with magnifying glass: 'Search courses, slugs, instructor...'
- Filter dropdowns: Category (All Categories, Advanced Excel, SQL & Databases, Power Query & ETL, Python, BI Dashboards), Status (All Statuses, Published, Draft, Scheduled, Processing), Instructor (All Instructors, CA Rohan Mehta, Elena Rostova, Marcus Chen, David Kalu)
- Sort dropdown: 'Sort by: Last Updated'
- Active Bulk Selection Bar: Display an elevated sticky/prominent bar showing '2 courses selected':
  - Action buttons: 'Publish (2)', 'Unpublish (2)', 'Duplicate', 'Archive', 'Delete (2)' (with red danger tone)
  - 'Clear selection' link

3. Comprehensive Courses Data Table:
Clean modern SaaS data table with crisp border dividers, subtle hover row state, checkbox for bulk select.
Columns:
- Checkbox (select all / row select)
- Course Info: High quality thumbnail badge/preview with level chip (e.g. 'Advanced', 'Intermediate'), Title ('Advanced Excel Masterclass: Dynamic Arrays & Financial Modeling', '/courses/advanced-excel-masterclass'), Category chip (e.g., 'Financial Modeling', 'Data Warehousing', 'Automation & ETL', 'Business BI')
- Instructor: Avatar + Name (e.g., CA Rohan Mehta, Elena Rostova, Marcus Chen, David Kalu)
- Pricing: INR ₹3,499 (struck ₹6,999) or ₹4,299 (struck ₹8,999) with discount pill
- Learners / Enrolled: e.g. 8,420 students, 4,150 students, 1,890 students
- Rating & Reviews: 4.9 ★ (3,420 reviews), 4.8 ★ (1,890 reviews)
- Status Pill:
  * Row 1: Published (emerald green badge with dot)
  * Row 2: Published (emerald green badge with dot)
  * Row 3: Processing videos (amber-500 pill with spinner/pulse indicator e.g. 'Transcoding 4K Lesson 14/26')
  * Row 4: Draft (neutral slate gray badge with dot)
  * Row 5: Scheduled (amber/blue badge 'Live Nov 15')
- Last Updated: e.g. 'Oct 24, 2024 by Rohan M.', 'Yesterday at 4:15 PM'
- Row Actions: Kebab (three dots) menu button with a dropdown preview showing: [Edit Details, Curriculum Builder, Batch Settings, Preview Page, Duplicate, Unpublish, Delete]

4. Pagination and Bottom Bar:
- 'Showing 1-10 of 28 courses'
- Standard pagination with 1, 2, 3 ... Next button, items per page selector (10, 25, 50).

5. Contextual Pro-Tip / Side Hint Card:
- Styled callout card: 'Curriculum Builder Tip' with a light indigo accent: 'Tip: Use the Curriculum Builder to drag-and-drop sections, upload lesson datasets (.xlsx, .pbix, .sql), and configure video watermark protection.' with a quick link 'Open Curriculum Guide →'.

Ensure crisp corporate SaaS typography (Inter), rounded-xl cards, slate-50 background, precise tabular alignment, and authentic enterprise LMS
